code_changes.title: Add call and inheritance edge extraction for the main code languages
code_changes.why: All code languages in the profile have 0% calls and 0% inherits (python 6138 files, php 5563, ruby 3001, rust 1752, go 1554, javascript 1222). Impact and path queries cannot follow calls across files without those edges.

reasons.why: The profile is code-dominated by chars (code 68% of chars, 5% of items). History is 92% of items but only 19% of chars, and prose is 7% of chars. The code strategy is the default graph and sets nothing. The conversation, media-metadata and records strategies all measured the same as the default (tune line_f1 0.1126 each, n 40, se 0.0302), so none is supported. Binary is under 1% of chars, so media-metadata does not apply.

Keep all settings at their defaults. The body-heavy candidate (bm25_body 4.0) scored 0.1103 against 0.1126, a drop of 0.0023, well under one se (0.0302), so it is noise and the simpler default stays. The name-light candidate scored 0.0959, a drop of 0.0167, still under two se (0.0604). No candidate beats the default. The tune set is small (n 40). Build keys stay at default: there are 11814 passages over only 922 nodes and p50 length is 52 chars, and no measure here tests them. Semantic mode stays unchanged. The entities step is not wanted: prose is 7% of chars and 1% of items.

Every code language in the profile shows 0% calls and 0% inherits. Call and inheritance edges are missing for all of them, so a call-edge backend is worth proposing. No tune figure measures the gain, so this is a proposal for the Judge to review and not a setting, and no gain is claimed.
